question: How many contributors worked on 4x-war and why did the work concentrate where it did?
sql:
WITH contributors AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT contributor) AS contributor_count
  FROM v_commit_file
  WHERE repo_slug = '4x-war'
),
component_stats AS (
  SELECT component,
         COUNT(*) AS files_touched,
         COUNT(DISTINCT contributor) AS contributors_in_component,
         SUM(insertions + deletions) AS churn
  FROM v_commit_file
  WHERE repo_slug = '4x-war'
  GROUP BY component
)
SELECT
  component_stats.component,
  component_stats.files_touched,
  component_stats.contributors_in_component,
  component_stats.churn,
  contributors.contributor_count AS total_contributors
FROM component_stats
CROSS JOIN contributors
ORDER BY component_stats.churn DESC
